scope: All 25 unique extant artifacts in three completed units, including scripts, original logs, later full records, independent LLM reviews, actual cross-source retraction and corrections.

checks: Strict UTF-8 JSONL with unique keys, exact schemas, finite integer values, and canonical decimal strings.
Declared 60-case Cartesian grid, legal parameters, protected disjoint-pair indices, saved mean and threshold constants.
All retained binomial numerators checked by an exact recurrence independent of the original comb implementation.
Tail denominator, term sum, rational bound numerator/denominator, and saved cross-products checked using integers.
All later review embedded sources matched by exact types and values; all independent values and PASS flags checked.
scope_limits: Finite retained-record verification, not a proof over all M, theta, corruption budgets, words, or attacks.
No samples, original diagnostic reruns, model initializations, original scripts, or new experimental records.
Later comprehensive and review archives do not recover the original diagnostic missing exact tails or failed-wrapper log.
No general order-two learning lower bound, novelty, asymptotic theorem, or citation validation is established here.
This module reads only the two numeric archives; the outer inventory must bind other source, note, review, and log files.

review_scope: Source-bound independent LLM reviews, not external peer review or formal proof. RESOURCE_DETAIL.md is author-only comparator bit-cost accounting outside its independent review.
missing_records: Original iid exact tails and term numerators were not retained. Failed wrapper output was not separately archived and Python did not start. Later complete archives are separate computations, not recovery.
scientific_boundaries: The iid gate result has explicit parameter/budget bounds. Actual cross-source lower-bound reasoning is retracted. Same unknown-source four-row training baseline and fresh-source prior experiment are distinct; prior depends on k, and its per-N inequality is conditional on clean risk epsilon, not sample impossibility or optimization success.
cost_and_novelty_limits: Full training trajectory acquisition costs N(M+3) symbols. The fresh-source result directly integrates accepted Appendix B.3; no new general statistical principle, learning algorithm or novelty certification is claimed.
historical_status: Original candidate headers and wording remain alongside later reviews/corrections. All current selected and nine inherited source identities match exactly, without rewrite of expected hashes. Older project recovery limits remain unchanged.
